before-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Don't talk to me! I don't have time for the likes of you!

before-the-fremennik-trials.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Lunar Diplomacy quest.

standard-dialogue-rellekka-without-a-sea.npc: You won't make many friends on Lunar Isle without your Seal of Passage.

options.text: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.

steps.player: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.

steps.text: Player is transported to Pirates' cove

options.text: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.

steps.player: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.

standard-dialogue-rellekka-with-a-seal-o.player: Hi Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?

standard-dialogue-rellekka-with-a-seal-o.npc: Sheesh, make your mind up [pal/lady], I'm not a taxi service!

steps.text: Player is transported to Pirates' cove

steps.player: Actually, I've changed my mind. Again. I don't want to go.

steps.npc: You are possibly the most indecisive person I have ever met...

standard-dialogue-pirates-cove.npc: Hi again [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you?

standard-dialogue-pirates-cove.text: If the player doesn't have a Seal of Passage:

steps.player: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?

steps.npc: Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.

options.text: Can you take me back to Rellekka?

steps.player: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?

steps.npc: Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?

steps.player: Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!

steps.npc: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!
